title: A lost game: any rule written is a hidden, unconfirmed note
shows: Pick-and-place lost with 3 failed retries. The Builder writes a Special Phenomenon note ("ensure the container is open before placing"). Because no attempt won, it is stored with verified=false and never shown to the agent, and a Success Process attempt is refused ("a failure may not write a Success Process rule").
why_interesting: The protection against learning wrong lessons from failure: guesses stay hidden until a later win confirms them.
notes: Logging quirk worth knowing: the log line says "rule_1 is a hidden Builder note" but the new hidden rule has id rule_3 (the id printed was assigned before the failure pools took ids rule_2 and rule_4).
